deNovoPca.centering: sklearn PCA centering after applying frozen discovery scaler

analysisSettings.frozenProjection: apply exact discovery 10-descriptor StandardScaler and exact canonical 4x10 component matrix
analysisSettings.principalAngles: scipy.linalg.subspace_angles between frozen 4D component subspace and heldout de-novo PCA 4D subspace

coordinateIngredients.description: exact discovery-side N-ACT/N-CON state-level scaler plus fixed mtaji classifier dependency

decisionRule.confirmed: all technical gates pass and G1-G5 all pass
decisionRule.inconclusive: integrity/replay/provenance fails or technical minimum trajectory population is not met
decisionRule.notConfirmed: technical gates pass and at least one of G1-G5 fails

executionBoundary.reasonFormalRunNotAuthorized: style ingredient definition hash must be frozen into this spec first

population.identityDedup: none; preserve within-trajectory consecutive state sequence
population.unit: one game trajectory containing both eligible namua and eligible mtaji states

G1_frozen_subspace_variance.metric: sum variance of frozen STYLE-C1..C4 heldout scores divided by total variance of the 10 discovery-standardized heldout descriptors

G2_de_novo_subspace_alignment.metric: principal angles between frozen 4D component subspace and heldout de-novo PCA 4D subspace in discovery-scaled descriptor coordinates

G3_behavioral_anchor_reproduction.metric: Spearman rho between each frozen coordinate score and its preregistered anchor descriptor

requirements: at least 6 of 8 associations preserve the preregistered sign with absolute Spearman rho >= 0.20
at least one qualifying non-anchor association for each STYLE-C1..C4

G5_trajectory_subsample_subspace_robustn.metric: p90 of maximum principal angle between frozen 4D subspace and de-novo PCA 4D subspace across deterministic heldout game subsamples

secondaryDiagnostics.conditionAssociation: report condition-group variance fraction for each frozen coordinate; metadata only
secondaryDiagnostics.coordinateDensity: report 1D GMM BIC and KDE shape for frozen scores; no cluster rescue or veto
secondaryDiagnostics.coordinateMoments: report means, standard deviations and quantiles
secondaryDiagnostics.heldoutDescriptorCorrelations: report full frozen-coordinate by descriptor Spearman matrix
secondaryDiagnostics.outcomeAssociation: optional report-only if available; never part of style definition or confirmation gate
